The idea of AI agents building and shipping sites is fascinating. As a designer, I'm always looking for ways to speed up development. How does Spacefast handle responsive design across different devices when the AI generates the site?

Connecting my AI agent and publishing with a simple request sounds too good to be true. What are the actual limitations of the free tier, and what kind of pricing model can we expect for scaling up? Automattic usually has solid infrastructure.

Another AI agent deployment platform. The Automattic name adds weight, but I need to see more than just 'connect and publish'. How does the feedback loop work in practice? Is it just comments, or can agents truly iterate based on user input?

Interesting to see Automattic in this space. Giving AI agents a place to build and ship is a smart move. Makes me wonder how this could integrate with our own internal tools for content generation. Good luck with the launch!
